surfaces.front_door: Google global external Application Load Balancer with serverless NEGs
surfaces.required_protection: Independent Cloud Armor policies and exact regional serverless NEGs on public, actions, console, chat, webhooks, and internal backends; LB-only Cloud Run ingress; no default URL except the preflighted private internal synthetic path; independent service and revision max caps
surfaces.trusted_client_identity: X-TrustedRouter-Client-IP overwritten by the load balancer from {client_ip_address}
surfaces.verification: manifest-bound scripts/deploy/rollout.sh staging and rollout_rollback.sh phased promotion/attempt-scoped rollback; exact-host three-domain URL-map totality preserving explicit API/AWS/Azure/Quill aliases; six backend/NEG/Cloud Armor/header postconditions; six direct Admin API checks; authenticated LB/browser smoke; private internal billing synthetic; rejected external run.app probes

surfaces.front_door: GCP regional L3/L4 gateway load balancers and attested Confidential Space workloads
surfaces.required_protection: provider-native L3/L4 DDoS controls and bounded gateway-local admission; no HTTP proxy that terminates TLS
surfaces.trusted_client_identity: socket/proxy-protocol identity owned by the gateway implementation, not the FastAPI edge header
surfaces.verification: gateway deployment must prove native DDoS policy attachment, bounded admission, and unchanged live attestation for every alias

surfaces.front_door: AWS App Runner public service resource
surfaces.required_protection: regional AWS WAF associated directly with every App Runner service; high per-IP ceiling enforced, host/write/common rules previewed first
surfaces.trusted_client_identity: AWS WAF is source-IP authoritative; application deliberately uses its conservative untrusted-lb bucket because App Runner cannot inject the exact edge header
surfaces.verification: aws wafv2 get-web-acl-for-resource for every App Runner service ARN and rule-shape verification in scripts/deploy/_aws_waf.sh

surfaces.front_door: AWS Global Accelerator to NLB to regional Fargate services
surfaces.required_protection: WAF-capable HTTP edge with origin restriction, without changing the api-aws attested path
surfaces.trusted_client_identity: the new edge must overwrite X-TrustedRouter-Client-IP and the origin must reject direct traffic
surfaces.verification: prove WAF attachment, direct GA/NLB origin rejection, and healthy aws.trustedrouter.com status and internal gateway dependencies

surfaces.front_door: AWS Global Accelerator to NLB to Nitro Enclaves
surfaces.required_protection: Shield Standard/native Global Accelerator and NLB absorption plus bounded enclave-local admission; Shield Advanced is an explicit paid decision
surfaces.trusted_client_identity: L4 client identity owned by the enclave gateway; no HTTP edge header
surfaces.verification: prove native protection and gateway limits without changing PCR0 or the attested certificate binding

surfaces.front_door: currently direct external Azure Container Apps ingress
surfaces.required_protection: Azure Front Door Premium WAF with Private Link to an internal workload-profile Container Apps environment, or an equivalent origin-locked WAF design
surfaces.trusted_client_identity: Front Door rule must overwrite X-TrustedRouter-Client-IP with {client_ip}
surfaces.verification: after explicit cost approval, prove WAF policy/route/private endpoint, raw Container Apps FQDN rejection, and healthy custom domain

surfaces.front_door: Azure regional public endpoints to SEV-SNP confidential workloads
surfaces.required_protection: Azure native L3/L4 DDoS tier selected explicitly plus bounded gateway-local admission; no Front Door TLS termination
surfaces.trusted_client_identity: network peer identity owned by the confidential gateway; no FastAPI edge header
surfaces.verification: prove native DDoS policy and gateway limits while live MAA/SEV-SNP attestation and enclave TLS remain unchanged
